login.title: Log in with username and password

register.title: New account
register.workspaceHint: You can invite others right after signing up.

recover.title: Restore access
recover.mailHint: Enter the email confirmed in your profile — we will send a link for a new password
recover.sent: If such an account exists and its email is confirmed, we have sent a link
recover.supportHint: No confirmed email — write to support
recover.externalHint: Linked Telegram or VK? Sign in with it and set a new password in your profile

external.stateMismatch: Sign-in could not be completed: start again from this tab

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Your account is ready. Check your username — workspace members find you by it
welcome.userNameHint: 3–20 characters: Latin letters, digits, “_” and “.”. Changing it is optional
welcome.passwordHint: Password is optional: set one to sign in with your username too

error.phoneTaken: This phone number is already registered
error.passwordAlreadySet: A password is already set — change it by entering the current one
error.lastLogin: This is your last way to sign in — set a password or link another one first
error.linkInvalid: The link is stale or already used — request a new one
error.tooManyEmails: The email is already on its way — wait a couple of minutes and check your inbox, including Spam
error.externalFailed: Could not sign in with Telegram or VK. Please try again
error.loginNotLinked: This Telegram or VK is not linked to any account — recover access by email
error.loginAlreadyLinked: Another login of this platform is already linked — unlink it first
error.loginTaken: This login is already linked to another account
error.unknownLogin: This login is not linked to any account yet
error.loginRecentlyLinked: This login was linked less than a day ago — for now, change the password by entering the current one
error.freshLoginRequired: Confirm it's you: enter your password or sign in again with Telegram or VK
error.deleteConfirmMismatch: Type your username to confirm the deletion
error.mergeTicketInvalid: The merge preview has expired — open it again
error.mergeChanged: The workspaces have changed since — review the merge again
error.mergeSameAccount: This is the account you are signed in to
error.mergeNoAccount: This login is not linked to any account — you can simply link it
error.mergeKeepYoungAccount: The other account was created less than a day ago — only the current one can be kept
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts — try again in 15 minutes
error.adminCannotBeDeleted: This account has an admin role — another admin has to remove it first

validation.loginEqualsPassword: The password must differ from the username
